description: EXPLORATORY (bean t7qv): translates the owner's constraint 1 < q_0 < phi and tests the prediction that the metallic ladder marks SDP regime changes. TRANSLATION (exact): since 1/phi = phi - 1, h(phi) = phi - 1/phi = 1 and h is strictly increasing, so 1 < q < phi is exactly 0 < h < 1 — below the first rung of the corpus's own metallic ladder delta_n = (n + sqrt(n^2+4))/2. At q_0, h = 0.20906. WHAT IT SECURES: one result, with margin — D_PN < 0 throughout, since its boundary q_c = 3.4580993 has h = 3.16892, over 3x the bound, so K always carries inverse-crossing (entanglement) content as a consequence of the bound rather than a measurement. It secures NONE of the positive-sector LP results, whose windows are strictly inside (1, phi). REGIME PREDICTION NOT SUPPORTED here: the Gram signature is constant (4,1,1) at every h from 0.2 to 4.5 across all four rungs, so the SDP cone never changes shape; the LP objective grows smoothly and its growth-rate maximum near h=1 is INHERITED — tr_M(free), a plain scalar with no LP in it, peaks at the same h = 0.9875, and the objective inherits it via the t = G e_1 row-1 bound; and the discrete flickers fall at h = 0.9, 2.9, 3.3, 3.4, 3.8, 3.9, off the rungs. The corpus's PR #1999 already recorded 'not a bifurcation' for per-block characters at H_3; this extends that negative to the cone and the H_9 selection. No fit; no B_AME; nothing wired.
caveats: SCOPE: this tests the observables a SELECTION regime would live in — the cone (Gram signature), the objective, and the discrete solution — at H_3 and H_9. A regime change could still live in something not formed here: a different algebra level, or a functional other than these. The negative is 'the metallic rungs are not distinguished in the SDP data at H_3 or the selection at H_9', not 'the metallic ladder is physically inert'.

The growth-rate maximum sits at h = 0.9875 with a 0.025 scan step, so it is within resolution of h = 1 and the maximum is very flat (0.2% above its neighbour). It is reported as INHERITED rather than absent, because tr_M(free) — which contains no LP — peaks at exactly the same h. Controls |t3| and |x_free| peak at h = 0.7125 and |G| at 0.9375.
